page.overview:
What is Mewtwo?

Mewtwo is a -type Legendary Pokémon who appears in MS016: Pokémon the Movie: Genesect and the Legend Awakened.

It has a similar background to the Mewtwo that appeared in Mewtwo Strikes Back, but is a distinct, separate individual.

Though it shares some aspects of its personality with the previous Mewtwo seen in the anime, this Mewtwo differs in a number of key ways. It is far less harsh in its hatred of humans, instead merely distrusting them and wishing to be left alone by them. It also merely asks Virgil, Anna and Oscar to forget they met it. This Mewtwo is able to sympathize and identify with others, as when it meets the Genesect Army, it insists that they go with it to a place where unnatural Pokémon should exist.

Mewtwo first appeared in Mewtwo — Prologue to Awakening, in which it was revealed to have escaped from its creators and had started roaming the world looking for a home.
